item.name: Create Person Monitoring Type Notification - PUSH

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Person Detection Push Alert",
  "description": "Push notification template for person detection alerts",
  "client_id": 1,
  "notification_channel": "PUSH",
  "message_template": "Alert: Person {{name}} detected at {{location}} on {{timestamp}}",
  "configuration": {
    "sender_name": "CCONet Security",
    "template_id": "push_template_01",
    "priority": "high",
    "badge_count": 1
  },
  "is_active": true
}

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Person Detection Email Alert",
  "description": "Email notification template for person detection alerts",
  "client_id": 1,
  "notification_channel": "EMAIL",
  "message_template": "Dear Security Team,\n\nPerson {{name}} (Document: {{document}}) was detected at {{location}} on {{timestamp}}.\n\nBest regards,\nCCONet Security System",
